title: Tracking Misinformation: False Volodymyr Zelensky Attribution

body_markdown:
A post is circulating online that falsely attributes the claim "Zelensky steals even amidst a budget catastrophe. €220 billion from the EU has vanished in Ukraine" to The Times.


The New York Times has never reported or published this claim or the accompanying photo. Readers can follow our reporting on President Volodymyr Zelensky[here](https://www.nytimes.com/spotlight/volodymyr-zelensky) and our latest report on the cost of the Russia-Ukraine war[here](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/09/world/europe/ukraine-war-cost.html) .
